title: Improve artifact reproducibility
body:
## Summary

Addresses the concerns raised by the second artifact reviewer (IISWC 2026 AE) so the archive is reproducible through its submitted instructions and configuration.

## Changes

- **Reproducible install** — pin `hardhat-deploy` to `0.11.23` (exact) and standardize on `yarn.lock` as the single frozen lockfile by removing `package-lock.json`.
- **Credential-free local execution** — Sepolia-only deploy scripts (`SignatureBounty`, `BountyFallbackAccount`) now skip on non-Sepolia networks, so local compile/test/deploy needs no `PRIVATE_KEY`/`INFURA_ID`.
- **Enabled experiments** — un-skip the headline cost-of-solving gas tests and raise the Mocha timeout to 600 s so they complete.
- **Documentation** — README documents the toolchain (Node 18.17.1, Yarn 1.22.22), exact install command, expected results table, and run commands.

## Verification

- `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` succeeds cleanly.
- `hardhat compile` and the fast test suites pass without credentials.
- `hardhat test --grep "Test the cost of solving the prime factoring bounty with 3072-bit key"` runs to completion within the timeout.
- `npx hardhat deploy --tags SignatureBounty` skips cleanly on the local network.

title: Quantum Bounty Update: paymaster time, configs, dependencies, and README improvements
body:
### Changes

- **Paymaster time update**: Updated paymaster timing parameters
- **Configs & dependencies**: Updated Hardhat config and project dependencies
- **Test timeouts**: Adjusted test timeouts for reliability
- **README improvements**: Added specific tests documentation and citations
- **Max gas / byte updates**: Updated gas limits and byte handling

title: Add 4608-bit keys
body: Includes deployments and cost tests for 4608-bit keys

title: Quantum bounty customizable gcd iterations
body: This adds a parameter to set the number of iterations done in one trigger to find the GCD of a base and modulus. This allows customization of gas cost per call when generating the puzzle.

title: Quantum bounty signature accumulator
body: This refactors the RsaUfoAccumulator to be used as an accumulator for arbitrary random bytes. This PR then uses it for address generation.

title: Quantum bounty delegate accumulators libraries
body: This makes the accumulators into libraries in order to prefer delegation over inheritance.

title: GCD uses multiple triggers
body: This separates the GCD from the accumulation call so that it can be done in multiple rounds. This avoids the gas limit.

title: Clearer message when attempting to solve before locks are generated
body: Previously, attempting to solve the bounty before the locks were generated would result in a IndexOutOfBounds error. This reverts with a more descriptive message.

title: Order finding
body: This adds a quantum bounty for [order-finding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shor%27s_algorithm#Quantum_order-finding_subroutine).

title: Sanity solution check
body: This provides a way for a solver to check that their code correctly commits and reveals so that they are not charged a large amount when trying to solve the large locks.

title: RSA-UFO
body:
This deploys a prime factoring quantum bounty by generating an [RSA-UFO](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-540-47942-0_21
) during initialization.

title: Estimate gas to deploy and solve RSA-UFO
body: This splits the quantum bounty deployment and solving into separate calls in order to remain under the transaction gas limit. This also has scripts to estimate the cost of each.

title: Bounty contract
body: Implements a contract that flips a flag if solved by someone who can imitate signatures.
